title: W E B A R E N A : A R EALISTIC W EB E NVIRONMENT FOR B UILDING AUTONOMOUS AGENTS
abstract: WebArena is a realistic and reproducible web environment designed to facilitate the development of autonomous agents capable of executing tasks. It comprises four fully operational, self-hosted web applications, each representing a distinct domain prevalent on the internet. We release a benchmark with 812 long-horizon web-based tasks, focusing on evaluating the functional correctness of task completions.

sections.title: The Core Insight
sections.content:
Imagine you're browsing the internet, and you want to create a travel itinerary. You need to navigate through multiple websites, search for information, and make decisions based on that information. Autonomous agents can help you with this task, but they need to be trained in a realistic environment.

WebArena is a web environment that simulates real-world scenarios, allowing agents to learn and improve their decision-making skills.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.content:
WebArena consists of four fully operational, self-hosted web applications, each representing a distinct domain: e-commerce, social forum discussions, collaborative software development, and content management. Utility tools like maps and calculators are also available to support human-like task executions.

The environment is designed to mimic the web browser experience, with options to render page content in different modes, such as HTML, screenshots, or accessibility trees.

sections.title: Benchmark Results
sections.content:
We evaluated several baseline agents on the WebArena benchmark, which consists of 812 long-horizon web-based tasks. The best GPT-4-based agent achieved an end-to-end task success rate of 14.41%, while human performance was 78.24%.

These results highlight the need for further development of robust agents that can effectively perform complex tasks in real-world scenarios.

sections.title: Why This Matters
sections.content:
The development of autonomous agents that can effectively perform complex tasks in real-world scenarios has significant implications for various industries, including customer service, healthcare, and education. WebArena provides a realistic and reproducible environment for training and evaluating these agents, allowing for more accurate assessments of their capabilities and limitations.

By improving the performance of autonomous agents, we can enhance the overall efficiency and effectiveness of various tasks, leading to increased productivity and better decision-making.

sections.title: Key Innovations
sections.content:
WebArena introduces several key innovations, including a realistic and reproducible web environment, a benchmark suite of web-based tasks, and a evaluation framework that assesses the functional correctness of task executions.

These innovations enable the development of more effective autonomous agents that can perform complex tasks in real-world scenarios, leading to significant improvements in various industries and applications.

sections.title: Try It Yourself
sections.content:
WebArena is publicly available, and you can try it out yourself. The environment and benchmark suite can be accessed through the WebArena website, and the code is available on GitHub.

By experimenting with WebArena, you can gain a deeper understanding of the challenges and opportunities in developing autonomous agents that can perform complex tasks in real-world scenarios.
